$comment: QUARANTINE — values that appear in the supplied artifacts but must never enter
These are not errors in our reading; they are defects in the source material.
Recording them here rather than as a set literal in code means each carries its
reason, and adding one does not require a code change.
A quarantined value is still REPORTED by build_dictionary.py so it stays visible.
Silently dropping it would be as bad as silently trusting it.

values.why: Unreplaced template placeholder on the Traveler Print button in the reference page. Treating it as a real action id would produce a button wired to nothing.
Same placeholder, the actionButtonId half. The reference page may itself be unfinished.

Our own marker for something a generator could not determine. If it ever appears in a source file it is noise, not vocabulary. Also catches base-tenant identifiers that legitimately end in .UNKNOWN, e.g. a Spark DriverState enum member.
